tools.description: Acknowledge an open alert.
tools.name: acknowledge_alert

tools.description: Crawl a URL via Crawl4AI and ingest it as evidence (normalized, deduplicated, provenance-tracked). Returns document_id and dedupe status. When `await_embed=true`, blocks up to 30s for the embed worker to finish so a follow-up semantic_search returns this document.
tools.name: crawl_url

tools.description: Create a claim bound to evidence (§43: at least one evidence document REQUIRED). Optionally links entities (created if missing). Level 2 governed.
tools.name: create_claim

tools.description: Create an entity in the intelligence graph (typed intent → schema validation → PG canonical + Neo4j relationship memory). Level 2 governed.
tools.name: create_entity

tools.description: Create an agent finding bound to evidence (directive §28/§29: claims must cite supporting/contradicting evidence; findings are agent inference, never presented as verified fact).
tools.name: create_finding

tools.description: Create a new investigation (first-class object: target/question/hypothesis).
tools.name: create_investigation

tools.description: Create a typed relationship between two existing entities (endpoints must exist — create them first). Level 2 governed.
tools.name: create_relationship

tools.description: Fetch a document by URL: returns the stored evidence if already collected, otherwise crawls and ingests it first.
tools.name: fetch_document

tools.description: Fetch deep fundamentals for a US ticker via financialdatasets.ai (8 endpoints: profile/statements/segments/13F holders/insider KPI/guidance). Level 2 governed; responses are cached 30 days in Postgres (pay-per-request provider — a cache hit costs nothing).
tools.name: financials_fetch

tools.description: Contradictions touching a claim (by claim_id) OR any claim about an entity (by entity_id). Exactly one must be supplied.
tools.name: find_contradicting_claims

tools.description: Find the shortest path between two entities in the knowledge graph. v2: temporal-aware, weighted by 1-confidence. Replaces v1 (no back-compat: v1 was unused in production).
tools.name: find_path

tools.description: Relationship changes between two entities (by name fragment, case-insensitive). Most recent first, optional time window.
tools.name: find_relationship_changes

tools.description: Claims that cite this entity, joined with documents that support them (supports-only by design; use find_contradicting_claims for the opposing half).
tools.name: find_supporting_claims

tools.description: Get YOUR current budget state (GREEN/YELLOW/RED/KILL) with today's usage vs limits (§58–60). Self-throttle accordingly.
tools.name: get_budget_status

tools.description: Get a stored document by id (content + metadata + provenance).
tools.name: get_document

tools.description: Get an entity by id with aliases, outgoing relationships, and claims (resolves `merged_into` to the parent if applicable).
tools.name: get_entity

tools.description: Audit timeline of an entity and its relationships (graph_change_log filtered by entity + relationship target_id).
tools.name: get_entity_timeline

tools.description: Get a stored evidence document including provenance chain (source, retrieval time, content hash) and the findings that reference it.
tools.name: get_evidence

tools.description: Variable-length neighborhood expansion in the graph (depth default 2, clamped 1..=4, optional temporal filter at `at_time`, post-filter on rel_types/min_confidence).
tools.name: get_neighbors

tools.description: Aggregate system health: Postgres, Redis, Neo4j, Qdrant, SearXNG, Crawl4AI latencies + docker container states.
tools.name: get_system_health

tools.description: Get the status of a task (search/crawl/ingest/analysis).
tools.name: get_task_status

tools.description: Hybrid retrieval over evidence: keyword + vector channels fused with reciprocal-rank fusion (§41 candidate set → rerank → evidence set).
tools.name: hybrid_search

tools.description: Investigate a question: rule-based planner runs hybrid search + entity lookup + graph traversal + existing-claims lookup, returns synthesized evidence chain. Each step is its own sub-trace.
tools.name: investigate

tools.description: Keyword full-text search over stored evidence documents.
tools.name: keyword_search

tools.description: List alerts from the unified alert center (§54): severity, source, links, recommended action.
tools.name: list_alerts

tools.description: Documents that cite this entity via claim_evidence. relation defaults to "supports". Side-effect: writes observations rows (idempotent).
tools.name: list_evidence_for_entity

tools.description: List investigations, optionally filtered by status.
tools.name: list_investigations

tools.description: List all available MCP tools (name + one-line description). Use this first when an error says 'missing field X' to discover the canonical argument name. Read-only, no budget cost, not audited.
tools.name: list_tools

tools.description: Mute an open alert (stops dedupe-bumping and webhook noise for this alert).
tools.name: mute_alert

tools.description: Query entities in the relationship graph by name (read-only, parameterized — no arbitrary Cypher).
tools.name: query_entity

tools.description: Findings + entities + claims for an investigation (joins via claim_entities + findings.investigation_id).
tools.name: query_investigation_graph

tools.description: List relationships of an entity in the graph (read-only, parameterized).
tools.name: query_relationship

tools.description: LEVEL 3 (requires X-Admin-Token, default DENY per §61): run a whitelisted lifecycle action on a component — upgrade|rollback|backup via the pinned VM scripts.
tools.name: run_component_action

tools.description: Search entities by name with alias-aware matching. Returns up to `limit` matches with scores.
tools.name: search_entity

tools.description: Search the web via the SearXNG federated sensor. Returns normalized results (url/title/snippet/engine).
tools.name: search_web

tools.description: Semantic similarity search over embedded evidence (vector channel, §39–42). Falls back to labeled keyword results only when nothing is embedded yet.
tools.name: semantic_search

tools.description: Query monitor time-series observations (macro FRED/EIA/Treasury, market quotes, sentiment). Series are self-describing with units, e.g. fred:VIXCLS, fred:CPIAUCSL_YOY, quote:AAPL, sentiment:AAPL, eia:WTI_SPOT_USD_BBL.
tools.name: signal_query

tools.description: Return the full input schema (param names/types/required/description) for one MCP tool by name. Read-only, no budget cost, not audited.
tools.name: tool_schema

tools.description: Update an investigation's fields (title/question/target/hypothesis/status).
tools.name: update_investigation

tools.description: v2 batch claim extractor (no evidence required — for LLM extractor pipelines that pick claims out of documents). Mirrors REST POST /api/v1/v2/extract_claims. Each claim is a separate transaction; audit rows drive the Neo4j mirror worker. Level 2 governed.
tools.name: v2_extract_claims

tools.description: Manage the monitor market watchlist (add/remove/toggle/list). The markets collector quotes enabled symbols every 6h; finintel tracks their news/insiders/sentiment hourly. Level 2 governed.
tools.name: watchlist_manage
